decision_reason: This is the NIST Voting Common Data Format Test Method: a documented machine-executable conformance tool intended for voting-system manufacturers, accredited test labs, and election-system implementers. NIST distributes prepackaged versioned releases and current CLI documentation; the repository's NIST-Software license text matches the OSI-approved NIST Software License. The v1.0.0b1 source release was published in 2023, establishing the first defensible year of public licensed code.

public_source.note: The NIST repository publicly exposes the source pipelines, scripts, configuration, test data, and builds without credentials.

eligible_license.note: I compared the complete LICENSE.md at the 2023 v1.0.0b1 tag and current main with OSI NIST-Software: substantive text matches, including the requirement to acknowledge NIST, the modification notice, risk allocation, and U.S. employee copyright statement; there is no legacy foreign-rights reservation. This applies to NIST-developed tool source only; test data has a separate license and third-party libraries retain their stated GPLv3, MPL-2.0, MIT, and Apache terms.

primary_evidence.note: The current NIST product page describes the tool's conformance purpose, intended users, tested environments, prepackaged GitHub releases, and links official usage documentation with CLI commands and supported CDFs. NIST last updated the page 2026-09-28.
